summary.headline: Monthly Weather Omens
summary.text: Astrological and weather omens for June through September: thunder, eclipses or darkening of the sun and moon, halos, falling stars, lightning, and earthquakes portend famine, war, disease, mortality, political upheaval, crop conditions, and invasion. July also prescribes numerous ritual prohibitions and interprets the moon’s orientation as favorable or unfavorable.
